professional_summary:
My journey began in 2022 with a foundational Higher Certificate in Information Technology, where I first discovered my passion for breaking down complex computing logic and system mechanics. That initial milestone ignited an intense commitment to rigorous software engineering, leading me to pursue a National Diploma in Information Technology (Software Development) at Nelson Mandela University from 2023 through 2025. During those academic years, I deliberately pushed myself beyond theoretical coursework: I dove deep into object-oriented design and network fundamentals through Cisco's CCNAv7 curriculum, discovering early on that building great software requires an intimate understanding of the underlying network pathways, packets, and infrastructure.

Between 2024 and 2025, I took my first direct industry steps as a Web Development Intern at Hex Software and subsequently as a Software Integration Intern at Kion Consulting. These roles exposed me to the harsh realities of real-world enterprise codebases—messy integrations, brittle interfaces, and legacy systems. I faced the steep learning curve of translating abstract classroom design patterns into robust production APIs, live client pipelines, and managing complex database schemas across SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Concurrently, in 2025, I stepped forward as Assistant Manager of Tech & Innovations for GeekKulchaNMU. Stepping into mentorship while still learning myself was a formative challenge; facilitating C# workshops and organizing hackathons forced me to articulate software concepts simply and precisely, refining my communication and confirming that true mastery comes from empowering others to solve difficult problems.

As my software projects matured—spearheading the enterprise Hospital Management System in C# and ASP.NET Core, and building Smart CV Builder—I realized that writing efficient code was only half the battle. If applications cannot be reliably provisioned, secured, and scaled, their impact collapses. This mindset shift pushed me straight toward cloud infrastructure and DevOps. Confronting the intimidation of cloud networking and distributed systems, I tackled multi-cloud fundamentals (earning the Microsoft Azure AZ-900 certification) and immersed myself in Amazon Web Services. I embraced the discipline of Infrastructure as Code, mastering Terraform and Docker to replace manual configuration with automated, reproducible blueprints—culminating in my design of a multi-AZ 3-Tier Containerized AWS Architecture and event-driven serverless solutions.

Now based in Johannesburg and working as a Junior Cloud Engineer at UVU Africa (Capaciti), I operate at the convergence of cloud infrastructure and generative AI. In 2026, I proved my problem-solving resilience on a national stage by leading an agentic AI implementation to 4th place at the AWS Summit Johannesburg GameDay challenge. Today, my engineering philosophy is driven by contextual problem-solving: whether eliminating financial documentation friction with the Murex Minimalizer RAG assistant, bridging South African educational divides across isiZulu and isiXhosa with Siyafunda Siyapassa, or addressing local transit transparency with the BitRide transit API. I view obstacles not as roadblocks, but as design constraints that sharpen code efficiency, system resilience, and meaningful societal impact.
career_objectives: I aim to continue advancing my expertise in cloud-native architecture, generative AI integration, and scalable software solutions. My goal is to lead innovative projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies to solve complex real-world problems, particularly in the domains of financial systems, educational accessibility, and urban mobility. I am committed to continuous learning and professional growth, seeking opportunities to mentor emerging developers and contribute to the broader tech community.

projects.name: Murex Minimalizer AI Assistant
projects.description: Engineered an AI-powered financial trade-booking assistant that simplifies and accelerates complex trade-booking workflows by utilizing RAG retrieval over institutional documentation and vector stores.
highlights: Core Focus: Financial trade-booking workflow automation, context-aware semantic retrieval, and specialized domain prompt engineering.
Tech Stack: Python, Flask backend, OpenAI API, vector stores, and custom RAG retrieval pipelines.
Goal & Impact: Aimed to drastically reduce error rates and time spent navigating dense Murex documentation by providing instant, accurate, step-by-step trade configuration guidance.

projects.name: 3-Tier Containerized AWS Architecture
projects.description: Architected and provisioned a highly available, multi-AZ 3-tier web architecture featuring custom public/private subnets, managed NAT gateways, load balancing, and automated infrastructure as code.
highlights: Core Focus: Infrastructure as Code (IaC), zero-trust network segregation, high availability, and container orchestration.
Tech Stack: Terraform, AWS (VPC, Subnets, NAT Gateways, ALB, EC2, RDS PostgreSQL), Docker.

Goal & Impact: Built to eliminate single points of failure and automate cloud provisioning, creating an enterprise-grade blueprint with secure isolation between public web tiers, internal app servers, and private database subnets.

projects.name: Ticketless Parking System
projects.description: Designed a cloud-native automated parking validation system leveraging AWS serverless architecture, event-driven compute via Lambda, and relational data storage.
highlights: Core Focus: Event-driven serverless computing, automated license plate recognition, and real-time vehicle entry/exit auditing.
Tech Stack: AWS Lambda (Python), Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, RESTful API endpoints.
Goal & Impact: Aimed to eliminate physical paper ticketing bottlenecks and optimize cloud cost-efficiency by executing validation workloads strictly on-demand via serverless functions.

projects.name: Siyafunda Siyapassa
projects.description: Built an AI-driven educational tutoring platform providing real-time curriculum support and interactive problem-solving across English, isiZulu, and isiXhosa.
highlights: Core Focus: Educational equity, localized language processing, ultra-low-latency AI inferencing, and curriculum-aligned STEM tutoring.
Tech Stack: Python (Flask), Groq API (high-speed LLaMA/Mixtral inference), JavaScript, responsive frontend.

Goal & Impact: Developed to overcome language barriers in South African education, enabling students to learn complex academic concepts directly in their mother tongue with sub-second AI response times.

projects.name: Smart CV Builder
projects.description: Developed a full-stack automated resume generation web application allowing users to input structured career milestones and dynamically generate styled, downloadable PDFs.
highlights: Core Focus: Dynamic document compilation, reactive UI state management, and template automation.
Tech Stack: Vue.js frontend, Python (Flask) API, ReportLab PDF rendering engine, Bootstrap.
Goal & Impact: Solved the challenge of manual ATS-friendly formatting by allowing job seekers to input raw profile data and instantly compile production-ready, standardized PDF resumes.

projects.name: Hospital Management System
projects.description: Led team development of an enterprise digital hospital management portal with role-based access control, appointment booking, patient records, and staff management workflows.
highlights: Core Focus: Enterprise application architecture, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), relational database integrity, and healthcare operational workflows.
Tech Stack: C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, ASP.NET Identity, Entity Framework Core, Microsoft SQL Server.
Goal & Impact: Spearheaded team development to modernize clinical paper tracking, delivering a secure portal for staff shifts, patient record auditing, and automated doctor appointments.

projects.name: BitRide Transit & Taxi Fare API
projects.description: Constructed a transit estimation API specifically tailored for Gauteng minibus taxi routes, providing route mapping and dynamic fare calculations.
highlights: Core Focus: Informal public transit digitisation, spatial route mapping, dynamic algorithmic fare calculation, and REST API design.
Tech Stack: Python, Flask, RESTful endpoints, geolocation algorithms, structured transit routing data.
Goal & Impact: Addressed the lack of digitized transit information across Gauteng by providing commuter transparency on complex minibus taxi ranks, stops, and price structures.

projects.name: James Local Voice Assistant
projects.description: Created a lightweight local desktop voice assistant integrating speech-to-text, fast neural text-to-speech synthesis, and conversational generative AI models.
highlights: Core Focus: Conversational AI integration, low-latency audio capture, localized neural text-to-speech synthesis, and custom prompt personality control.
Tech Stack: Python, Google Gemini API, Kokoro TTS, SpeechRecognition library, PyAudio.
Goal & Impact: Built an offline-capable/hybrid personal voice interface capable of executing rapid hands-free desktop tasks with natural vocal cadence and concise conversational responses.

projects.name: Nail Artist Portfolio Platform
projects.description: Designed and deployed a responsive commercial marketing website featuring interactive portfolio galleries, service pricing catalogs, and client booking inquiry funnels.
highlights: Core Focus: Responsive mobile-first UI/UX, brand positioning, interactive client galleries, and conversion funnels.
Tech Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (DOM manipulation), Bootstrap framework.
Goal & Impact: Built for a small beauty enterprise to transition from direct messaging to a professional web presence, improving brand reach and streamlining client service inquiries.
